strategyReview: Working: the Polymarket NO/YES-overpricing edge remains the strongest book—panel cuts (FIND-0065/0067/0069/0070) still show 58–78% win rates against a 49% base with positive holdout means, while ONE_TOUCH_HIGH_EDGE_NO live is 4/4 at +18.42% and USER_PM_IV_TOUCH_RICH_NO shadows are 9/10. The clean weekend HL funding reversion family is also profitable in aggregate (425/612 live, +0.18%; 188/253 shadow, +0.99%). Failing: per-name shadow-mined funding thresholds (CBRS/AAPL/MU) have decayed to 38–50% win rates, the GOLD no-bias/one-touch cap-edge families are mis-authored as spot >2% calls when their real payoff is contract premium decay, and the HYPE-confirmation BTC continuation setup is 36% over 25 tests.

failureClusters.evidence: CBRS is 15/33 (45%), AAPL 13/26 (50%), and MU 8/21 (38%). Examples repeatedly show funding oscillating around -10% to +5.5% and false triggers, not a reliable normalization edge.
failureClusters.recommendation: Refine these to regime-relative deep panics plus an already-turning normalization condition rather than continuing to reset the static -10% threshold.

failureClusters.theme: Spot-direction exams attached to contract-edge signals
failureClusters.evidence: H-532 and H-534 have 5 and 7 unscorable tests respectively, and the realized outcomes are contract P&L moves of a few cents or terminal NO payoffs, not >2% GOLD spot declines.
failureClusters.recommendation: Re-author these as contract premium-decay trades using contract-side keys and neutral direction, not spot-move predictions.

failureClusters.evidence: The cross-asset family is 9/25 (36%). Wins cluster in the strong late-summer BTC trend while losses occur near local highs, indicating the setup marks late participation rather than durable continuation.
failureClusters.recommendation: Flip to a late-stage FOMO fade or require independent IV/flow filters before taking BTC continuation longs.

newHypotheses.description: Refinement of H-539: replace the single static threshold with a regime-relative CBRS funding panic that is already turning higher. The original < -10 trigger captured flat/pre-crash states; requiring bottom-20% 7-day percentile and positive 24h change targets the actual normalization event.
newHypotheses.prediction: CBRS perp rises >1% within 2 days after a deep funding panic has begun normalizing.

newHypotheses.prediction: Selling YES / holding NO on qualifying GOLD above-strike tail contracts is profitable over 3 days as the cap edge compresses.

newHypotheses.prediction: AAPL spot/perp rises >1% within 2 days after a weekend funding panic begins normalizing.

hypothesisReviews.observation: Single cbrs_hl_funding_ann < -10 triggers both noise and genuine panics; test outcomes show funding oscillating around -10% to +14% with multiple false signals, and the family is 15/33 (45%) with no stable normalization edge.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A single CBRS funding reading below -10% reliably normalizes within two days and forces >2% CBRS spot gain.

hypothesisReviews.observation: Tests are 15/28 scorable and 5 unscorable because the prediction is written as a >2% GOLD spot decline while the signal is a NO-contract edge; realized contract moves are a few cents and do not correspond to spot declines.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A large no-bias adjusted gap on rich GOLD tail NO contracts reliably predicts a >2% spot decline within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The static AAPL funding < -10 test is coin-flip; examples show flat 5.5% and small moves, and wins are inconsistent. The single 24h threshold does not isolate weekend panic events.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: AAPL funding below -10% on any day reliably normalizes and yields a >2% spot gain within 2 days.

hypothesisReviews.observation: The HYPE-confirmation long BTC set is 36% across 25 tests; wins cluster in the strong late-summer BTC trend while losses occur when HYPE risk-on is present near local BTC highs, indicating the condition marks late participation rather than durable continuation.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: HYPE spot above its 24h SMA with stable OI independently confirms durable BTC upside rather than late-stage FOMO or overextension.

hypothesisReviews.observation: H-534's parent is 8/23 scorable with 7 unscorable; examples are contract P&L and terminal outcomes, not spot declines, and several gold one-touch NO contracts simply sat unchanged, confirming the spot-direction test is the wrong exam.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A large gold underlying-cap edge on upside one-touch NO contracts reliably predicts a >2% GOLD spot decline within 2 days, rather than paying via contract premium decay.

hypothesisReviews.observation: Single MU funding < -10 is weak (8/21) and examples show frequent oscillation from 5.5% to negative and back; no stable normalization edge from a single threshold.
hypothesisReviews.invalidatedAssumption: A single MU funding reading below -10% reliably normalizes and produces >2% MU spot gain within 2 days.

journalEntry: Tonight's main lesson is that many struggling shadow-mined variants are not just weak—they are tested on the wrong outcome or the wrong condition. GOLD no-bias/one-touch edge families need contract-P&L exams, not spot >2% calls. The per-name funding reversion signals need regime-relative extreme conditions plus normalization turn, not static -10% thresholds. The clean house edge continues to be YES overpricing localized through the panel cuts; we added tight-spread and liquidity-guarded near-dated NO siblings under FIND-0067 and FIND-0069 rather than adding more loose panel variants. No weekendFundingEntryPct change was made because the weekend-clustered shadow p-value remains above 0.05 and the live weekend evidence is not significant.
